name: Tierra
description: Pioneering artificial life system created by Thomas Ray in 1991 that implements digital evolution through self-replicating machine-code organisms competing for CPU time and memory. Tierra demonstrated that open-ended evolution, parasitism, and ecological dynamics can spontaneously emerge in a purely digital substrate.
reputation: Historically landmark artificial life system; foundational reference in the ALife and evolutionary computation literature.
notes: Historical system with limited active development; source code available but tooling is dated. Primarily of scholarly and historical significance.
